notes.title: Demo update notes for v0.37
notes.content:
Truck City v0.37-Demo has just been released. This is the change log:



Improvement: peak RAM usage reduced by ~10% by optimizing UI resources

Feature: map editor implemented, but not available in the demo

Feature: map editor integration with steam workshop

Feature: Esc key will open the menu if Esc is kept pressed for 0.6 seconds.

Feature: Added SSIL enable/disable option to Video settings menu

Bugfix: UI text corrections, translations improved

notes.title: Demo update notes for v0.36
notes.content:
Truck City v0.36-Demo has just been released. This is the change log:



Improvement: added video tutorial for the blueprints window, visible when no blueprints exist in the library

Bugfix: fixed bug where blueprints would not be correctly loaded

Bugfix: building a road out of town after changing market configuration would not correctly set the market configuration

Improvement: minimap color palette changed to improve resource visibility

Bugfix: log scrolling corrected

Bugfix: building placement rotation may fail in some cases

Improvement: improved translations

Improvement: truck depot added as a destination in the truck list window

Improvement: fixed window resizing on blueprints menu

Improved: shortcuts for window management

notes.title: Demo update notes for v0.35
notes.content:
Truck City v0.35-Demo has just been released. This change log also includes changes in hotfixes 0.34.1 and 0.34.2. This is the change log:

Improvement: Upgraded Godot engine to version 4.5

Improvement: First run sped up, the game now includes pre-compiled shaders (20% speed-up)

Improvement: minimap colors improved to make factories and resources much more visible, visually appealing

Improvement: added level of detail models for containers; makes GPU frame time approximately 10% faster in very factories with far away zoom

Improvement: updated tileset for Oil and Space DEMO map, especially for one way roads

Improvement: performance improvements when using blueprints

Bugfix: blueprints system may not save blueprints used by the user, corrected

Bugfix: "Map never completed" may show in the objectives menu after completing a map and selecting to stay in the map

Bugfix: one way roads in blueprints occasionally may not be correctly built

Bugfix: rarely blueprints may be built on top of resources, other buildings, or out of bounds, fixed

Bugfix: some blueprints may print "unable to build this blueprint" after building it

Improvement: Camera angle changed, camera transition changed

Improvement: better translations for leaderboards

Improvement: improved look and feel of Leaderboards window

Improvement: added button to go to my rank in Leaderboards window

Bugfix: corrected tilemap for 2-tile production buildings next to loading ports

Improvement: Truck depot now shows information regarding incoming trucks and occupied and total parking spots

Improvement: Added encryption for records file, hopefully preventing or reducing cheating

Improvement: other anti-cheating measures taken to prevent custom maps to inject results on official map leaderboards

Balance: changed default traffic light duration to 5s (from 10s)

Improvement: factory window will show a cleaner interface at the frame it's loaded (previously might show outdated information)

Bugfix: trucks would select a truck depot by distance, disregarding priority

Improvement: changed default shortcut for blueprints menu to Control+B instead of B, so the window can be closed using the same shortcut without interfering with the user typing

Bugfix: blueprints with one way roads were not correctly updating the minimap when built

Bugfix: manually despawned trucks would still show their route on the map, removed

Improvement: one way tiles changed so right side of the road shows yellow marks and left side shows white marks (as is usually the case in reality)

Bugfix: clicking on log messages may also trigger clicks below the log too

Improvement: road menu items may be reverse cycled using the Shift+2 shortcut

Improvement: Key mapping menu sorted by function key

Improvement: Added translation for market menu

Improvement: Removed incorrect tooltip text in global menu

Bugfix: Information tooltip text window now resets when scrolling or zooming

Bugfix: corrected warning message in factory tooltip text regarding amount of outbound warehouses

notes.title: Demo update notes for v0.34
notes.content:
Truck City v0.34-Demo has just been released. This is the change log:

Feature: Trucks list window now allows sorting by column

Bugfix: roundabouts and blueprints including one-way roads now correctly set the road direction

Improvement: camera will be completely top-down (90º) when it's far from the ground

Bugfix: factory rounding error that might cause uneven production ratios corrected

Balance: lowered production speed for rocket launchpads

Improvement: user interface cleanup

Improvement: other minor UI improvements such as faster scrolling in science menu, better placement for loading port menu.

Improvement: traffic light duration defaults to 5, limited to 99 seconds.

notes.title: Demo update notes for v0.33
notes.content:
Truck City v0.33-Demo has just been released. This is the change log:

Feature: search bar in loading port building menu is now always visible.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45672321/48095f429c7bdf4ff2e1a03eddca2c5b9ab8abb2.png"]

Improvement: tutorial 1 added road tile next to loading port to make the tutorial more intuitive

Improvement: tutorial 3 will wait until sufficient input warehouses are built, and will wait for individual factories to be completed before jumping to the next one

Feature: loading ports missing buildings will show a flashing ! sign on top of them. The objective is providing a more visual feedback to the player that the factory is not ready to be productive.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45672321/2973204df1c8048aae80bb1b9163da35ca2777db.png"]

Feature: zooming implemented in the science menu

Improvement: better factory error state reporting

Improvement: translated some missing error messages. Improved existing translations

Improvement: destroy SFX volume -5db 

Bugfix: full dependency graph may become unresponsive in some circumstances

notes.title: Demo update notes for v0.31
notes.content:
Truck City v0.31-Demo has just been released. This is the change log:

Improvement: yielding on roundabouts implemented

Improvement: two way roads yield when merging into one-way roads

Improvement: n-phase traffic lights exclude outbound one-way roads from arbitrage

notes.title: Demo update notes for v0.30
notes.content:
Truck City v0.30-Demo has just been released. Note this changelog takes over from v0.29-Playtest, and is the version of the first demo release.

This changelog also includes patch changes in v0.29.1, v0.29.2, v0.29.3. v0.29.4, and v0.29.5

Feature: added traffic lights

Feature: added nuke easter egg

Feature: added truck manual despawn button

Feature: added hover sound when moving the mouse over buttons

Feature: science menu supports WASD for navigation

Bugfix: corrected truck preview in trucks list menu

Improvement: science menu now shows different colors for each science

Bugfix: removed volumetric fog temporal reprojection to prevent light leak visual glitch

Feature: added roundabouts

Bugfix: added safeguards to prevent crash

Bugfix: improved container texture cache

Improvement: added information on one-way direction

Improvement: texture cache now saved to disk for faster access

Improvement: lateral bar mini buttons made bigger

Improvement: translations improved

Improvement: minor adjustments to tutorials and missions

Improvement: hotkey handling improved

Improvement: added market menu in F11. Blueprints use B instead of F11 now.

Bugfix: phantom container would remain on trucks even after unloading
